note: Twelve invented pro golfers. The names, bios and colors are made up and can be edited freely here; ids are what saves refer to, so keep each id the same when renaming. Stats are on the campaign scale (30 to 95) and every pro's five stats add up to the same total (matched level). No pro is based on a real person.

pros.name: Teodor Kellbrook
pros.bio: Hits it further than anyone on tour and keeps it low when the wind gets up. Grew up on an airfield course with no trees and a lot of wind.

pros.name: Rook Tavenner
pros.bio: Long and high. Likes to fly the ball over trouble rather than around it, and says the sky has no bunkers.

pros.name: Amara Quellwood
pros.bio: Plays every approach to a number and rarely misses a green from the fairway. Keeps a notebook of yardages for every course she has seen.

pros.name: Saskia Ferroway
pros.bio: A former junior archery champion who aims at flags the way she aimed at targets: straight at them, every time.

pros.name: Iker Solvane
pros.bio: Can stop a wedge on a table top. Practices around the green for three hours for every hour on the range.

pros.name: Ezio Marchbank
pros.bio: Prefers the ground to the air. If there is a way to run the ball onto the green, he will find it.

pros.name: Pell Greywater
pros.bio: Reads greens by walking them twice, once each way. Holes more long putts than anyone and never seems surprised by it.

pros.name: Wynn Kesterton
pros.bio: Quiet, patient, and very hard to beat once the ball is on the green. Plays to the safe side of every flag and trusts the putter.

pros.name: Maeve Duncairn
pros.bio: Learned the game on firm seaside ground and still plays it that way: low, running, and happy in a gale.

pros.name: Ottilie Strand
pros.bio: Never panics in a bad lie. Treats every awkward stance as a puzzle and usually solves it with a three-quarter swing.

pros.name: Juniper Ashcombe
pros.bio: No weakness to speak of and no single strength either. Wins by making fewer mistakes than everyone else.

pros.name: Kofi Brightwater
pros.bio: A steady all-rounder with a knack for escaping trouble. Smiles after bogeys, which annoys his playing partners.
